title: Retail Transition Supplies Aligned to Run Out Together (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, the starting length of a retail transition supply follows the member's other transition supplies, so that they run out together. The member's transition-fill history is read for transition supplies of other drugs that are dated inside the current transition window, meaning a fill date on or after the transition start date. The dispensing channel recorded on each fill is noted.

## Clause

- **(a) Specialty supply running.** The member's latest specialty transition supply of another drug is dated inside the current transition window and is still running on the handling date. The starting length is the days from the handling date through that supply's last day: its days supply less the days from its fill date to the handling date.
- **(b) Home-delivery supply running.** No such specialty supply is running, but the member's latest home-delivery transition supply of another drug is dated inside the window and still running. The starting length is the days from the handling date through that supply's last day, counted the same way.
- **(c) Otherwise.** The starting length is the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill, which is **30** days on every Northbridge formulary.

A supply is still running when its days supply less the days from its fill date to the handling date is more than zero.

The supply is then worked from this starting length. It is held between zero and the formulary's maximum for one transition fill only at the end, and taken in whole days.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical, handling date 20 May, transition start date 1 May)

| Transition supplies of other drugs on record | Starting length |
|---|---|
| specialty, filled 10 May, 30 days (runs 20 more days) | 20 days |
| specialty, filled 10 April, 30 days (dated before the window opened); home delivery, filled 5 May, 30 days | 15 days, from the home-delivery supply |
| specialty, filled 2 May, 14 days (ran out on the handling date: 14 less 18 is not above zero); no home-delivery supply | 30 days |
